title: Why We Should Be Optimistic About the Future

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Many skeptics thought the internet would never reach mass adoption, but today it’s shaping global culture.
reader_summary.overview: Many skeptics thought the internet would never reach mass adoption, but today it’s shaping global culture, is integral to our lives -- and it's just the beginning. In this conversation from our 2019 innovation summit, Kevin Kelly (Founding Executive Editor, WIRED magazine) and Marc Andreessen sit down to discuss the evolution of technology. *** The views expressed here are those of the individual AH Capital Management, L.L.C.
